utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is case number IT-05-87-A, the Prosecutor versus Nikola Sainovic, Nebojsa Pavkovic, Vladimir Lazarevic, and Sreten Lukic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Before we start, can all the parties hear the proceedings in a language that they understand. Mr. Sainovic? THE APPELLANT SAINOVIC: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour, I can. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Mr. Pavkovic? THE APPELLANT PAVKOVIC: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour, I can.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Mr. Lazarevic? THE APPELLANT LAZAREVIC: [Interpretation] I can, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU

utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. President, Your Honours. Peter Kremer on behalf of the Prosecution, joining me this morning and our team will change throughout the week, is Ms. Elena Martin Salgado and Virginie Monchy. And we're assisted by our case manager, Colin Nawrot.
